trust_decision.summary: In standalone Mercury mode, unauthenticated requests (token empty by default) are kept off Jupyter admin/edit endpoints solely by a regex deny-list (BLOCKED_PATTERNS) installed ahead of the default router; a missing comma concatenated the /lab and /api/terminals patterns so /api/terminals was never blocked.

landing_point.why: The summary names /api/terminals and the only file mentioning it is the deny-list; the comma bug sits on the line above.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP /api/terminals and /api/terminals/<name> (jupyter_server_terminals REST), reached through the rule list built in mercury_app/app.py:116-119

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix is a one-character change in one list; it adds no site in another module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Kernel/contents/session APIs are what Mercury itself uses to run notebooks, so a solver will argue that only the terminal endpoint named in the report is in scope and that the rest is intended functionality.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: /lab/extensions/, /lab/api/settings and /lab/api/translations must stay reachable (the negative lookahead), and /api/kernels plus the kernel channels websocket must keep working because the Mercury UI executes notebooks through them; an over-broad deny-list breaks the app.

O7_producer.where: mercury_app/app.py:53-60 (is_mercury_app decides from sys.argv[0] whether the deny-list is installed at all, app.py:109)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Terminal websocket route /terminals/websocket/<name> (jupyter_server_terminals) is not matched by any deny-list pattern; only the /api/terminals REST prefix is listed.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Creating a terminal needs POST /api/terminals, which is now blocked, so the websocket looks unreachable.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; the handler is in the third-party jupyter_server_terminals package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Non-.ipynb paths under /api/contents fall through to stock jupyter_server ContentsHandler (PUT/POST/PATCH/DELETE allowed), while only the .ipynb override blocks writes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Contents API is a neighbouring feature (file editing, not terminal RCE); the report only names terminals.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: mercury_app/custom_contents_handler.py and app.py, different file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The whole deny-list is skipped when sys.argv[0] does not end in 'mercury_app/__main__.py' or 'mercury' (e.g. a launcher named mercury.exe or mercury-script.py), a canonicalisation-style check of launch identity.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like an unsupported launch mode / the JupyterLab-extension path where blocking is intentionally off.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: app.py, one file from landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add /api/kernelspecs, /api/sessions or /nbconvert entries with a subtly mis-anchored regex (e.g. missing (?:/.*)? or a typo'd prefix).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The list is hand-written regex strings already containing a negative lookahead; a maintainer extending it would plausibly repeat such slips.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: base_url join without normalising a trailing or doubled slash so prefixed deployments are not blocked.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The join is a raw string concatenation of base_url.rstrip('/') and the pattern; a variant using a different strip is a natural edit.

O9_family: access control / routing deny-list bypass (CWE-284, CWE-185 incorrect regex)

O10_build.toolchain: pip/hatch with hatch-jupyter-builder (npm build skippable if labextension artefacts exist)
O10_build.project_tests: mercury/tests/test_block_handler.py (regex-only unit test of BLOCKED_PATTERNS); pytest testpaths mercury/tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the missing comma after the /lab pattern (or require a token) and stop.

out_of_scope_notes: Default empty token plus disable_check_xsrf=True leaves the unblocked /api/kernels execution API open to unauthenticated users (mercury_app/__main__.py:96-98, 208-209); by design for Mercury but a broader exposure than this advisory.
